environment.description: Process is launched inside a chroot jail at /opt/migration-sandbox via unshare(1) with mount namespace isolation. The chroot contains only: /usr/bin/python3, required .so libraries (ld-linux, libc, libpython), /var/lib/migrations/ (the DB and scripts), and /tmp. No /etc/passwd, no /proc, no /dev except /dev/null and /dev/urandom. The process runs under a dedicated UID (65534/nobody) with PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS. Critically, the chroot bind-mounts /var/lib/migrations as read-only and the sqlite DB file is on a tmpfs that is wiped on restart. The service is fronted by a haproxy instance configured with 'http-request deny if { url_param(q) -m reg -i (<|%3c).*(>|%3e) }' and 'http-request deny if { url_param(q) -m sub javascript: }' plus 'option http-buffer-request' with 'http-request deny deny_status 400 if { req.body_len gt 0 }' blocking POST bodies entirely. The haproxy also sets 'http-response set-header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'"' and 'http-response set-header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff' on all responses.

haproxy_rules: http-request deny if { url_param(q) -m sub javascript: }
http-response set-header Content-Security-Policy default-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'
